title: Find a soccer club in/near Bentonville that exceeds BPR Soccer in scope.

research.summary: Sporting Arkansas and Prodigy FC are the top competitive soccer clubs located directly in Bentonville that offer advanced academy pathways exceeding the recreational scope of Bentonville Parks & Recreation (BPR). For a player born in 2018, the appropriate transition is to a U9 Academy program which introduces structured training, professional coaching, and local tournament play.
steps: Register Miles for Sporting Arkansas Academy evaluations, which are free to attend and cover 2016-2019 birth years.
Review Prodigy FC's competitive program as a strong, locally-based alternative in Bentonville.
Look into Arkansas Comets FC in nearby Springdale if you want to evaluate the oldest and most established elite club in Northwest Arkansas.
Check Upstart Athletics (F.C. Horizon) for an additional competitive youth club option serving ages 7-18.
Email the club directors to confirm practice locations, travel commitments, and season deadlines before committing.

title: Decide what stays and what goes for the house move

research.summary: Sorting possessions before a move reduces packing time, lowers transportation costs, and ensures a cleaner start in your new home. By applying structured decision rules like the 4-box method and leveraging local Bentonville donation and hauling services, you can rapidly offload unwanted items without getting bogged down.
steps: Tackle one room at a time using the 4-box method: Keep, Sell, Donate, and Trash.
Apply the 6-Month Rule to clothing and miscellaneous items: if it hasn't been used in six months, let it go.
Measure bulky furniture against your new home's floor plan to immediately eliminate items that will not fit.
Take gently used clothing and furniture to local charities like Helping Hands or Habitat ReStore in Bentonville.
Book a local junk hauler to do a final sweep of any broken or un-donatable debris before moving day.

research.summary: A successful divorce recovery plan must prioritize stabilizing your daily routine for single parenting with ADHD, actively processing abandonment trauma and PTSD, and building a strong local support system. Utilizing high-structure scheduling alongside trauma-informed therapy will help mitigate anxiety and insomnia while establishing a healthy new baseline for you and your son.
steps: Schedule a consultation with a local trauma-informed therapist specializing in PTSD and ADHD (e.g., Compass Counseling or Ozark Psychotherapy).
Design a strict, high-structure Wednesday-Sunday routine to support ADHD management and provide stability for Miles.
Join a Bentonville-based or virtual divorce support group (like DivorceCare) to combat feelings of abandonment and isolation.
Implement a strict evening wind-down protocol and explore Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) to address chronic nightmares and sleep loss.
Perform a complete financial and logistical audit to separate accounts, set a single-income budget, and reduce cognitive load.
